rules: No full-screen gradients. Keep background purely black/dark grey.
Use #2997FF ONLY for active states, small text links, or subtle hover highlights.
Ensure text over any media maintains 4.5:1 contrast using gradients or scrims.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] font-black tracking-tighter leading-none uppercase
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#A1A1AA]

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tighter).
Overlines and small labels must be Uppercase, Mono, and widely spaced.
Never center align body text. Keep reading patterns natural (left-aligned).

layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Asymmetrical layout with massive kinetic text on the left/center and a subtle floating/parallax abstract visual on the right. Must include an on-load masked line-by-line reveal for the headline.
layouts.showreel: Container with massive horizontal padding. The video frame starts clipped (small) and scales up to 100% width on scroll using Framer Motion.
layouts.about: Asymmetrical Grid. A column for 'Numbered Manifesto Chapters' (01, 02, 03) paired with large, bold statements. Ample negative space (gap-16 to gap-24).
layouts.projects: Filterable gallery. A sticky header or sidebar for categories (Motion Graphics, Video Editing -> sub-categories). Project items should be large bento-style cards or full-width list items with cinematic poster images and hover-to-reveal interactions.
layouts.marquee: Full-width, extremely slow-moving editorial marquee for client logos. Low contrast (dark grey on black).
layouts.contact: Massive typography 'LET'S TALK' at the top. Split layout: Left side with direct info (Discord, Email), Right side with a clean, minimal Shadcn-based form with custom dark styling.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Container should use px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangular. 1px border border-[#27272A]. Hover state fills with white and inverts text to black. Accent buttons can use #2997FF.
components.project_card: Cardless or extremely subtle 1px border. The focus is the video thumbnail. On hover: scale image slightly, dim overlay, reveal 'Play' icon or title.
components.filters: Pill-shaped toggle buttons. Active state: bg-white text-black. Inactive: text-[#A1A1AA] hover:text-white.
components.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60, 1px bottom border border-white/10. Fixed to top. Logo on left, links center, 'Let's Talk' CTA right.
components.video_player: Standard iframe for YouTube/Vimeo, but wrapped in a container with a custom minimal poster image. Ensure 16:9 aspect ratio (aspect-video).

interactions: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY.
On-load: Line-by-line text reveal for Hero H1 using Framer Motion (overflow-hidden wrapper, y: 100% to 0%).
Scroll: Showreel video container scales from 80% to 100% width on scroll.
Hover: Project cards have a subtle scale (1.02) and image reveal.
Micro: Custom cursor (optional, but a subtle dot that expands on hover adds to the Apple feel).

rules: Images must be wrapped in overflow-hidden containers.
Never use bare tags for decorative images; always style them with object-cover.
Apply grayscale or black/white filters to logos.

guidelines: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure proper aria-labels on icon buttons and video players.
Use sr-only classes for visually hidden labels on the contact form.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page hybrid fullstack app focusing entirely on motion and aesthetics.
Use Framer Motion heavily for the hero line-by-line reveal, showreel clipping, and project card hovers.
Use Shadcn UI for the Contact Form and Dropdowns, overriding the styling to match the dark Apple-minimal theme.
Ensure the Projects section has a working filter state (Motion Graphics vs Video Editing -> Subcategories).
Use react-fast-marquee for the client logos section.
Do NOT center-align the main App container.
Embed actual placeholder iframes (e.g., standard YouTube embed links) for the video projects, masked behind the cinematic video placeholders.
